static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute capturing primary diagnoses and comorbid conditions relevant to the course of trauma-focused CBT (e.g., PTSD, depression, substance use, personality disorder, cognitive impairment).

static_dimensions.dimension_name: Trauma History and Index Trauma Type
static_dimensions.description: A fixed representation of the nature and context of the user’s traumatic experience(s), including developmentally-timed or repeated trauma.
Key categorical attributes such as age group, gender identity, sexual orientation, cultural/ethnic background, education/intellectual level, and veteran/military status.
The user's baseline cognitive functioning that affects engagement with therapy (e.g. cognitive impairment, developmental challenges).
The user’s selected/assigned mode of therapy delivery.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the current intensity and patterning of PTSD and related symptoms during therapy.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updated periodically based on patient self-report, standardized symptom measures, and therapist assessment throughout the course of sessions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Represents current categories of maladaptive beliefs/distortions ('Stuck Points') central to the user’s post-trauma thoughts (e.g., self-blame, distrust, overgeneralization).
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Adjusted as cognitive processing exercises and Socratic questioning help shift beliefs from rigid/maladaptive to balanced perspectives during therapy.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Reflects current mood and capacity for experiencing and tolerating emotions (e.g., avoidance, numbness, excessive affect, effective regulation).
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes in response to trauma processing, exposure, homework assignments, and evolving insight, tracked session by session.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Measures the user's ongoing participation with therapy tasks, assignments, session attendance, and willingness to engage with challenging material.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Re-evaluated at every session based on task completion, observed effort, reported motivation, and therapist assessment.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Captures current willingness to approach trauma memories, challenge stuck points, and participate actively in recovery.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updates as patient expresses shifts in willingness, demonstrates engagement with assignments, and responds to feedback/intervention.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Represents the ongoing influence of social or family/support network on recovery efforts and engagement.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updates as life circumstances, relationships, or external support changes (positively or negatively) during therapy.

dynamic_dimensions.description: Reflects the presence of beliefs or circumstances that actively hinder progress in therapy.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Reassessed at key points when engagement drops, assignments are missed, or patient expresses doubt or reluctance towards therapy.

dynamic_dimensions.dimension_name: Progress in Core Themes (Safety, Trust, Power/Control, Esteem, Intimacy)
dynamic_dimensions.description: Tracks shifts in central CPT domains as the patient’s beliefs and behaviors evolve across therapy.
options: Rigidly maladaptive beliefs in multiple domains
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updated after major exercises, Stuck Point reviews, and therapist evaluation of cognitive and behavioral shifts.
